text:
maya: red team reported a lateral path between tenant-123 and tenant-456 in priv-onprem. metadata proxy -> control-plane port 9100. pinging sec + eng-infra for quick triage. @olivia @sam
sec-bot: Incident detected: redteam-alert RT-2026-031. Auto-tagged severity: medium. Follow the eng-security runbook. :rotating_light:
red-team: PoC snippet:
```
redteam$ curl --unix-socket /var/run/proxy.sock http://internal:9100/metrics?tenant=456
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
...agent metadata...
```
Chained with mis-scoped SA token to call KMS decrypt endpoint (169.254.169.254:8200/v1/transit/decrypt).
sam: Which pod + ns + cluster? Need pod logs and conntrack.
maya: pod=inference-proxy-7f8b, ns=tenant-123, cluster=prod-priv-eu. First seen ~1721001200 in proxy logs during canary.
leo: oncall check: netpol allowed egress to control-plane:9100 from that ns. Found netpol label `allow-controlplane-egress: true` — likely config drift after rollback. Quick grep: `kubectl -n tenant-123 logs inference-proxy-7f8b | grep 169.254` -> shows `GET /v1/decrypt` at 1721001215.
olivia: KMS audit shows decrypt requests from service-account `proxy-sa-tenant-123` at 1721001215. Need requester identity + key id. Recommend rotating ephemeral SA tokens and revoking currently issued ones as precaution.
maya: Did we push any RBAC changes recently? I recall an RBAC tweak to allow token exchange for proxies last week.
sam: Confirmed — MR #8423 relaxed `system:auth-delegator` for proxies to enable cross-tenant routing. I'm reverting now. Opening emergency MR to roll back the change.
leo: Forensics: snapshot pod and collect logs: `kubectl -n tenant-123 cp inference-proxy-7f8b:/var/log/proxy /tmp/proxy-logs` -> uploaded to s3://sec-evidence/1721001234/. Evidence saved.
olivia: Action items (short):
1) Revert MR #8423 (sam)
2) Revoke SA tokens & invalidate sessions (sec)
3) Tighten KMS key policy to require mTLS + tenant claim (platform)
4) Add default deny netpol for tenant namespaces and explicit egress rules (eng-sre)
5) Increase audit alerting on decrypt frequency and retention (sec-ops)
sec-bot: Playbook step created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SI-1256 assigned to @sam @olivia @leo @maya :clock1:
sam: Revert MR deployed. Patching netpol to explicit deny/whitelist egress now: `kubectl apply -f deny-egress.yaml -n tenant-123`
maya: Good. For postmortem I'll start a doc: timeline, root cause (RBAC delta + netpol allow), exploited endpoints, KMS audit snapshot, and remediation checklist.
leo: Node-level check: ran `conntrack -L | grep 9100` — captured 3 entries: `10.0.4.22 -> 10.0.1.33:9100` at 1721001216. Saved output in evidence bundle.
red-team: Noted. This was limited to canary instances; no full data exfil detected beyond a test decrypt in KMS logs. Good catch on rollback window. :thumbsup:
olivia: After-action recommendations: block metadata-proxy sockets by default, require token audience checks on proxy SA, enforce tenant claim in KMS auth, add alert for decrypt >3/min, and add automated netpol linting in CI for tenant namespaces. I'll open infra change PRs today.
maya: assigning follow-ups in the postmortem doc. Thanks everyone for fast triage.
